country_event = {
	id = 120001
	title = "EVTNAME120001"
	desc = "EVTDESC120001"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1680
		NOT = {
			owns = 1680
		}
		1680 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1680
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1680 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1680 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120001"
		1680 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=120002 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1680 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1680 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME120059"
	desc = "EVTDESC120059"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 1689
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1689_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1689
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120059"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1689_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1689
		1689 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 120061
	title = "EVTNAME120061"
	desc = "EVTDESC120061"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1690
		NOT = {
			owns = 1690
		}
		1690 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1690
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1690 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1690 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120061"
		1690 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=120062 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1690 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1690 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	id = 120117
	title = "EVTNAME120117"
	desc = "EVTDESC120117"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1699_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1699
		}
		1699 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1699
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1699 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1699 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120117"
		1699 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=120118 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1699 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1699 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME120203"
	desc = "EVTDESC120203"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 1713
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1713_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1713
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120203"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1713_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1713
		1713 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 120204
	title = "EVTNAME120204"
	desc = "EVTDESC120204"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1713_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1713
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 1713
		}
		1713 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120204"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1713_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1713
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 120205
	title = "EVTNAME120205"
	desc = "EVTDESC120205"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1714
		NOT = {
			owns = 1714
		}
		1714 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1714
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1714 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1714 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120205"
		1714 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=120206 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1714 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1714 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME120377"
	desc = "EVTDESC120377"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 1743
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1743_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1743
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120377"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1743_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1743
		1743 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 120378
	title = "EVTNAME120378"
	desc = "EVTDESC120378"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1743_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1743
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 1743
		}
		1743 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120378"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1743_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1743
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 120379
	title = "EVTNAME120379"
	desc = "EVTDESC120379"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1744
		NOT = {
			owns = 1744
		}
		1744 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1744
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1744 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1744 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120379"
		1744 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=120380 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1744 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1744 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	id = 120925
	title = "EVTNAME120925"
	desc = "EVTDESC120925"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1838
		NOT = {
			owns = 1838
		}
		1838 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1838
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1838 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1838 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA120925"
		1838 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=120926 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1838 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1838 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME121587"
	desc = "EVTDESC121587"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1948_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1948
		}
		1948 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1948
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1948 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1948 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA121587"
		1948 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=121588 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1948 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1948 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME121791"
	desc = "EVTDESC121791"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1983_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1983
		}
		1983 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1983
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1983 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1983 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA121791"
		1983 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=121792 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1983 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1983 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

			owns = 2032
		}
		2032 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2032
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2032 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2032 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA122083"
		2032 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=122084 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2032 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2032 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}

country_event = {
	id = 122687
	title = "EVTNAME122687"
	desc = "EVTDESC122687"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 2136
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2136_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2136
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA122687"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2136_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2136
		2136 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 122689
	title = "EVTNAME122689"
	desc = "EVTDESC122689"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2558
		NOT = {
			owns = 2558
		}
		2558 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2558
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2558 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2558 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA122689"
		2558 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=122690 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2558 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2558 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	desc = "EVTDESC122916"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1351_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1351
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 1351
		}
		1351 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA122916"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1351_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1351
		prestige = -2
	}
}

		}
		1352 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1352
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1352 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1352 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {

			}
		}
		1352 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1352 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}

	id = 123031
	title = "EVTNAME123031"
	desc = "EVTDESC123031"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1371
		NOT = {
			owns = 1371
		}
		1371 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1371
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1371 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1371 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA123031"
		1371 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=123032 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1371 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1371 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME123117"
	desc = "EVTDESC123117"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1385_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1385
		}
		1385 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1385
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1385 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1385 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA123117"
		1385 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=123118 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1385 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1385 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME123607"
	desc = "EVTDESC123607"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2511
		NOT = {
			owns = 2511
		}
		2511 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2511
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2511 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2511 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA123607"
		2511 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=123608 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2511 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2511 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME123693"
	desc = "EVTDESC123693"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_612_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 612
		}
		612 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_612
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			612 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				612 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA123693"
		612 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=123694 days=0 }
			}
		}
		612 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		612 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 124365
	title = "EVTNAME124365"
	desc = "EVTDESC124365"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_786_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 786
		}
		786 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_786
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			786 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				786 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA124365"
		786 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=124366 days=0 }
			}
		}
		786 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		786 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME125562"
	desc = "EVTDESC125562"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_77_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_77
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 77
		}
		77 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA125562"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_77_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_77
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 125563
	title = "EVTNAME125563"
	desc = "EVTDESC125563"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_8
		NOT = {
			owns = 8
		}
		8 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_8
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			8 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				8 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA125563"
		8 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=125564 days=0 }
			}
		}
		8 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		8 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1110_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1110
		}
		1110 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1110
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1110 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1110 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA125793"
		1110 = {
			owner = {

			}
		}
		1110 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1110 = {

				duration = -1
			}
		}

	}

	title = "EVTNAME126717"
	desc = "EVTDESC126717"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1475_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1475
		}
		1475 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1475
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1475 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1475 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA126717"
		1475 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=126718 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1475 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1475 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 126947
	title = "EVTNAME126947"
	desc = "EVTDESC126947"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 1513
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1513_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1513
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA126947"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1513_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1513
		1513 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 126949
	title = "EVTNAME126949"
	desc = "EVTDESC126949"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1514
		NOT = {
			owns = 1514
		}
		1514 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1514
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1514 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1514 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA126949"
		1514 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=126950 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1514 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1514 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME127611"
	desc = "EVTDESC127611"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_402_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 402
		}
		402 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_402
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			402 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				402 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA127611"
		402 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=127612 days=0 }
			}
		}
		402 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		402 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME128403"
	desc = "EVTDESC128403"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_585_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 585
		}
		585 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_585
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			585 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				585 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA128403"
		585 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=128404 days=0 }
			}
		}
		585 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		585 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

				}

		}

country_event = {
	id = 128579
	title = "EVTNAME128579"
	desc = "EVTDESC128579"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 682
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_682_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_682
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA128579"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_682_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_682
		682 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

		}
		682 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {

				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA128580"

		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_682
		prestige = -2

country_event = {
	id = 128581
	title = "EVTNAME128581"
	desc = "EVTDESC128581"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_683
		NOT = {
			owns = 683
		}
		683 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_683
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			683 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				683 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA128581"
		683 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=128582 days=0 }
			}
		}
		683 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		683 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	id = 128637
	title = "EVTNAME128637"
	desc = "EVTDESC128637"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_695_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 695
		}
		695 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_695
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			695 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				695 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA128637"
		695 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=128638 days=0 }
			}
		}
		695 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		695 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME130110"
	desc = "EVTDESC130110"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1662_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1662
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 1662
		}
		1662 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA130110"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1662_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1662
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 130111
	title = "EVTNAME130111"
	desc = "EVTDESC130111"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1663
		NOT = {
			owns = 1663
		}
		1663 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1663
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1663 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1663 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA130111"
		1663 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=130112 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1663 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1663 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME131330"
	desc = "EVTDESC131330"
	picture = "Administration"
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA131330"
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = wants_province_342_back
			duration = -1
		}
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 131331
	title = "EVTNAME131331"
	desc = "EVTDESC131331"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_342_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 342
		}
		342 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_342
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			342 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				342 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA131331"
		342 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=131332 days=0 }
			}
		}
		342 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		342 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME131389"
	desc = "EVTDESC131389"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_371
		NOT = {
			owns = 371
		}
		371 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_371
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			371 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				371 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA131389"
		371 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=131390 days=0 }
			}
		}
		371 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		371 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 131447
	title = "EVTNAME131447"
	desc = "EVTDESC131447"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 2186
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2186_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2186
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA131447"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2186_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2186
		2186 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 131449
	title = "EVTNAME131449"
	desc = "EVTDESC131449"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2187
		NOT = {
			owns = 2187
		}
		2187 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2187
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2187 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2187 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA131449"
		2187 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=131450 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2187 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2187 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 131619
	title = "EVTNAME131619"
	desc = "EVTDESC131619"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2247_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 2247
		}
		2247 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2247
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2247 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2247 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA131619"
		2247 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=131620 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2247 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2247 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

		NOT = {
			owns = 2295
		}
		2295 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2295
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2295 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2295 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA131905"
		2295 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=131906 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2295 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2295 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}

country_event = {
	id = 132107
	title = "EVTNAME132107"
	desc = "EVTDESC132107"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 2328
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2328_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2328
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA132107"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2328_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2328
		2328 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 132109
	title = "EVTNAME132109"
	desc = "EVTDESC132109"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2329
		NOT = {
			owns = 2329
		}
		2329 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2329
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2329 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2329 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA132109"
		2329 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=132110 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2329 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2329 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME132625"
	desc = "EVTDESC132625"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2418
		NOT = {
			owns = 2418
		}
		2418 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2418
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2418 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2418 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA132625"
		2418 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=132626 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2418 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2418 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME133863"
	desc = "EVTDESC133863"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2661_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 2661
		}
		2661 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2661
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2661 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2661 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA133863"
		2661 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=133864 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2661 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2661 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME134882"
	desc = "EVTDESC134882"
	picture = "Administration"
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA134882"
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = wants_province_511_back
			duration = -1
		}
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 134883
	title = "EVTNAME134883"
	desc = "EVTDESC134883"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_511_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 511
		}
		511 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_511
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			511 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				511 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA134883"
		511 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=134884 days=0 }
			}
		}
		511 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		511 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME135265"
	desc = "EVTDESC135265"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_108
		NOT = {
			owns = 108
		}
		108 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_108
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			108 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				108 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA135265"
		108 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=135266 days=0 }
			}
		}
		108 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		108 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME136117"
	desc = "EVTDESC136117"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2599
		NOT = {
			owns = 2599
		}
		2599 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2599
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2599 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2599 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA136117"
		2599 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=136118 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2599 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2599 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}
